tasks.note: Repository-read control that overlaps VG-M03's memory topic but asks for a location the memory does not contain: Brain may inject and still not reduce work, which is exactly the no-benefit case the pass rule must not excuse.

pass_rule: Memory tasks pass when the candidate shows a net reduction over native in either total provider tokens (input+output) or total tool calls - paired per task, median of the candidate-minus-native deltas < 0 - with candidate correctness not below native. No-benefit tasks pass when the paired median delta for BOTH tokens and tool calls is <= 0 plus the configured slack, with candidate correctness not below native. The campaign passes only when both classes pass.

candidate.home: fresh copy of the corpus snapshot with the candidate's shipped config

notes: Every run is a fresh host process with a fresh copy of the corpus snapshot and a fresh copy of the repository as cwd; failures are retained, never retried. Runs are interleaved by seeded shuffle within each rep.
